name: ClaudeCodeExtension
headline: Claude Code VS .NET扩展
short_description: A Visual Studio .NET extension that provides a better interface for Claude Code CLI, OpenAI Codex and Cursor Agent with support for multi-line prompts and image attachments for high productivity and vibe coding
author: dliedke

sections.overview:
Claude Code Extension brings AI-assisted coding directly into Visual Studio as a dockable terminal panel. It supports Claude Code, Cursor Agent, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, and other AI providers, allowing developers to run agents without leaving the IDE. The extension enables multi-line prompts with file and image attachments, formatted code selection insertion, and an integrated diff viewer for Git projects. Features include prompt history, custom slash commands, session resumption, and Claude usage tracking. It simplifies .NET and full-stack development workflows by combining editor context with AI agent capabilities in a single tool window.
Running Claude Code or Cursor Agent directly in Visual Studio without external terminals
Attaching images and files to AI prompts for context-rich coding assistance
Reviewing uncommitted Git changes in a dedicated diff viewer while prompting agents
Saving and reusing custom commands and canned prompts for repetitive tasks
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/dliedke/ClaudeCodeExtension`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
